title_en: China Great Wall Asset Management Corporation, Jinan Office v. China National Heavy Duty Truck Group Jinan Truck Co., Ltd. and Shandong Xiaoya Group Co., Ltd. — dispute over loan mortgage contract
ruling_gist_en: Mortgage guarantee is a guarantee in rem. Where the mortgagor is not the principal debtor, the mortgagee may request auction or sale of the mortgaged property to obtain priority satisfaction, but may not request the mortgagor to directly assume the debtor's obligations.
keywords_en: Civil; dispute over loan mortgage contract; second instance; Supreme People's Court; Shandong Province; legal person; financial institution; Security Law; Contract Law; whether mortgagee may request mortgagor to directly assume debt when mortgagor is not principal debtor; method of realization of mortgage; reversal of judgment; loan contract; mortgage guarantee; assignment of creditor's rights; asset restructuring; contract dispute; mortgage right; guarantee; mortgage; dispute over loan mortgage contract of a limited liability company
full_text_en:
China Great Wall Asset Management Corporation Jinan Office v. 
China National Heavy Duty Truck Group Jinan Truck Co., Ltd. and 
Shandong Xiaoya Group Co., Ltd.
— Dispute over loan and mortgage contract

【Ruling Summary】

Mortgage guarantee is a form of security over property. Where the mortgagor is not the principal debtor, the mortgagee may request the auction or sale of the mortgaged property to obtain priority of payment, but may not request the mortgagor to directly assume the debtor's debt.

Civil Judgment of the Supreme People's Court
(2007) Min Er Zhong Zi No. 25

Appellant (Plaintiff at First Instance): China Great Wall Asset Management Corporation Jinan Office, domiciled at No. 168, Jingqi Road, Jinan City, Shandong Province.
Responsible Person: Ni Fuxing, General Manager of the Office.
Agent ad litem: Li Lun, attorney at Shandong Deyi Law Firm.

Appellee (Defendant at First Instance): China National Heavy Duty Truck Group Jinan Truck Co., Ltd., domiciled at South End of Dangjia Town, Shizhong District, Jinan City, Shandong Province.
Legal Representative: Wang Haotao, Chairman of the Board.
Agent ad litem: Yan Bingxin, employee of the Company.
Agent ad litem: Li Wenxue, attorney at Shandong Shengyuan Law Firm.

Defendant at First Instance: Shandong Xiaoya Group Co., Ltd., domiciled at No. 51, Gongye South Road, Jinan City, Shandong Province.
Legal Representative: Zhou Youzhi, Chairman of the Board.
Agent ad litem: Cui Jingyang, employee of the Company.
Agent ad litem: Zhou Bin, employee of the Company.

The appellant, China Great Wall Asset Management Corporation Jinan Office (hereinafter referred to as Great Wall Company), appealed to this Court against the civil judgment (2006) Lu Min Er Chu Zi No. 17 rendered by the Shandong High People's Court in the dispute over a loan and mortgage contract with the appellee, China National Heavy Duty Truck Group Jinan Truck Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as CNHTC Jinan Truck Company), and the defendant at first instance, Shandong Xiaoya Group Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Xiaoya Group). This Court formed a collegial panel in accordance with the law, with Judge Jia Wei serving as presiding judge, and acting judges Sha Ling and Yuan Duoran participating in the trial. Yuan Hongxia served as court clerk. The trial of this case has now been concluded.

The Shandong High People's Court found the following facts upon trial:

1. On September 2, 2003, the East Suburb Branch of the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, Jinan (hereinafter referred to as the East Suburb ICBC) and Shandong Xiaoya Electrical Appliance Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Xiaoya Stock Company) entered into a working capital loan contract numbered 2003 Dong Liu Zi No. 0022, stipulating: the loan amount was RMB 5.4 million; the purpose of the loan was to repay the principal owed by the borrower to the lender under the loan contract numbered 2003 Dong Liu Zi No. 004; the loan term was from September 30, 2003, to September 25, 2004; and the method of guarantee was mortgage. On the same day, the mortgagor, Xiaoya Stock Company, and the mortgagee, East Suburb ICBC, entered into two mortgage contracts numbered 2003 Dong Di Zi No. 0022A and 2003 Dong Di Zi No. 0022B, respectively, each stipulating that the mortgagor would provide mortgage guarantee for the above loan of RMB 5.4 million using real property and land.

2. On September 2, 2003, East Suburb ICBC and Xiaoya Stock Company entered into a working capital loan contract numbered 2003 Dong Liu Zi No. 0023, stipulating: the loan amount was RMB 7.7 million; the purpose of the loan was to repay the principal owed by the borrower to the lender under the loan contract numbered 2003 Dong Liu Zi No. 004; the loan term was from September 30, 2003, to September 25, 2004; and the method of guarantee was mortgage. On the same day, the mortgagor, Xiaoya Stock Company, and the mortgagee, East Suburb ICBC, entered into two mortgage contracts numbered 2003 Dong Di Zi No. 0023A and 2003 Dong Di Zi No. 0023B, respectively, each stipulating that it would provide mortgage guarantee for the loan of RMB 7.7 million under the above loan contract using its real property.

After the conclusion of the mortgage guarantee contracts described in paragraphs 1 and 2 above, under the supervision of the Jinan Municipal Bureau of Land and Resources, Xiaoya Stock Company and East Suburb ICBC entered into two contracts for the mortgage of state-owned land-use rights. The contracts respectively stipulated: the mortgaged plot was located at No. 73, Dongweizi Outer Street, Lixia District, Jinan City; the land certificate number was Lixia Guoyong (2003) No. 0100216; the mortgage was on 1,950.80 square meters of transferred industrial land; and the amount of the mortgage loan was RMB 2.7 million. The other contract stipulated: the mortgaged plot was located at No. 38, Erqi Middle Street, Shizhong District, Jinan City; the land certificate number was Shizhong Guoyong (2003) No. 0200231; the mortgage was on 5,710 square meters of transferred industrial land; and the amount of the mortgage loan was RMB 5.2 million. After the conclusion of the above mortgage contracts, the Jinan Municipal Bureau of Real Estate Administration registered the mortgaged real properties, and the Bureau of Land and Resources registered the mortgaged land, and issued certificates of title over real property. On October 8, 2003, Xiaoya Stock Company repaid RMB 10,000 of the principal of each of the above two loans.

3. On September 26, 2003, East Suburb ICBC and Xiaoya Stock Company entered into a working capital loan contract numbered 2003 Dong Liu Zi No. 0024, stipulating: the loan amount was RMB 74.9 million; the purpose of the loan was to repay the principal owed by the borrower to the lender under the loan contracts numbered 2001 Lixia Dong Liu Zi No. 004 and 2003 Dong Liu Zi No. 004; the loan term was from September 30, 2003, to September 25, 2004; and the method of guarantee was mortgage. On October 8, 2003, RMB 10,000 of the principal was repaid, leaving an outstanding principal of RMB 74.89 million.

4. On September 26, 2003, East Suburb ICBC and Xiaoya Stock Company entered into a working capital loan contract numbered 2003 Dong Liu Zi No. 0026, stipulating: the loan amount was RMB 15 million; the purpose of the loan was to repay the principal owed by the borrower to the lender under the loan contract numbered 2003 Dong Liu Zi No. 0025; the loan term was from October 27, 2003, to October 27, 2004; and the method of guarantee was mortgage. On November 3, 2003, RMB 10,000 of the principal was repaid, leaving an outstanding principal of RMB 14.99 million.

On September 26, 2003, the mortgagor, Xiaoya Stock Company, and the mortgagee, East Suburb ICBC, entered into a maximum amount mortgage contract numbered 2003 Dong Di Zi No. 0024, stipulating that for the two loan contracts described in paragraphs 3 and 4 above totaling RMB 89.9 million, the mortgagor would provide mortgage guarantee using its machinery and equipment. Both parties registered the mortgage with the Shandong Provincial Administration for Industry and Commerce and obtained a mortgage registration certificate.

The total principal amount of the above four loans was RMB 103 million. After deducting the RMB 40,000 already repaid on the four loans, the outstanding principal was RMB 102.96 million.

5. On July 23, 2005, the Shandong Branch of the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (hereinafter referred to as Shandong Branch) and Great Wall Company entered into an assignment of creditor's rights agreement, primarily stipulating: the creditor's rights assigned by Shandong Branch to Great Wall Company were the loan principal and interest owed by the debtor, Xiaoya Stock Company, to Shandong Branch; as of April 30, 2005, the book value of the creditor's rights under this agreement was RMB 102.96 million in principal plus corresponding interest.

On December 22, 2005, Shandong Branch and Great Wall Company jointly published in the 6th edition of Dazhong Daily a notice of assignment and demand for payment regarding the outstanding loan principal of RMB 56 million owed by the borrower, Xiaoya Group Washing Machine Branch (hereinafter referred to as Xiaoya Washing Machine Branch), and the guarantor, Xiaoya Group.

6. On November 3, 1997, the People's Government of Shandong Province, by letter (1997) Lu Zheng Zi No. 266, approved the establishment of Xiaoya Stock Company by Xiaoya Group. On August 19, 1999, the China Securities Regulatory Commission approved the public issuance of 90 million shares of social public stock, i.e., Renminbi ordinary shares, by Xiaoya Stock Company. The registered capital of Xiaoya Stock Company was changed to RMB 253.975 million, with Xiaoya Group holding 47.87% of the equity of Xiaoya Stock Company.

7. On August 8, 2003, Shandong Haitian Certified Public Accountants Co., Ltd. issued an asset restructuring appraisal detailed list (Lu Hai Hui Bao Zi (2003) No. 038) for Xiaoya Stock Company. The appraisal result showed total liabilities of RMB 913.7261 million and net assets of RMB 379.4636 million.

8. On August 8, 2003, East Suburb ICBC, Xiaoya Stock Company, Jinan Electric Motor Factory (hereinafter referred to as Motor Factory), Jinan Household Electrical Appliance Factory (hereinafter referred to as Household Appliance Factory), and Xiaoya Group entered into an agreement. The preamble of the agreement stated: Motor Factory and Household Appliance Factory would transfer to Xiaoya Stock Company all their respective real properties located at No. 73, Dongweizi Outer Street, Jinan, and No. 38, Erqi Middle Street, Jinan, to settle debts. In 2003, China National Heavy Duty Truck Group Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as CNHTC Group) decided to restructure and acquire Xiaoya Stock Company. By acquiring the state-owned shares of Xiaoya Stock Company held by Xiaoya Group, it aimed to achieve a backdoor listing. After the asset swap restructuring, Xiaoya Group would repurchase the assets of Xiaoya Stock Company used for washing machine production and establish Xiaoya Electrical Appliance Co., Ltd. (tentative name). During the restructuring process, Xiaoya Stock Company requested East Suburb ICBC to issue a confirmation letter confirming the creditor's rights and undertaking that the creditor's rights would be transferred along with Xiaoya Stock Company's assets to the newly established Xiaoya Electrical Appliance Co., Ltd. In response to the creditor's rights guarantee, East Suburb ICBC required Xiaoya Stock Company to increase the collateral and undergo new mortgage procedures. To this end, the five parties negotiated and reached the following agreement: 1. Motor Factory, Household Appliance Factory, and Xiaoya Group agreed to transfer the ownership of the above two real properties to Xiaoya Stock Company, and during the transfer process, the parties would allow reasonable area deviations. 2. Xiaoya Stock Company and Xiaoya Group undertook to complete the assignment, transfer, and registration of the real properties listed in Article 1 to Xiaoya Stock Company before August 31, 2003. 3. After the completion of the matters listed in Article 2, the equipment of Xiaoya Stock Company as listed in the schedule of the original maximum amount mortgage contract numbered 2000 Lixia Dong Di Zi No. 001 would be mortgaged, and a new loan contract and mortgage contract would be signed with East Suburb ICBC, with the registration procedures to be completed before September 26, 2003. 4. East Suburb ICBC would issue a confirmation letter to Xiaoya Stock Company confirming the creditor's rights, and the creditor's rights of East Suburb ICBC would be transferred along with the assets repurchased by Xiaoya Stock Company to the newly established Xiaoya Electrical Appliance Co., Ltd. 5. If any one of Xiaoya Stock Company, Motor Factory, Household Appliance Factory, or Xiaoya Group failed to perform the obligations set forth in Articles 1 to 3, the confirmation letter issued by East Suburb ICBC would become void, and the debt would continue to be borne by Xiaoya Stock Company.

On the same day, East Suburb ICBC issued a confirmation letter to Xiaoya Stock Company. The main content of the letter was: "Upon consideration, we agree that after your company's asset swap restructuring, the creditor's rights we hold in your company shall be transferred together with your company's assets to the newly established Shandong Xiaoya Electrical Appliance Co., Ltd. (tentative name). This is hereby confirmed."

9. In 2003, CNHTC Group and Xiaoya Group entered into an asset transfer agreement and an asset swap agreement, stipulating the asset swap, asset swap price, settlement of interim gains and losses, the term and method of the asset swap, representations and warranties of Xiaoya Stock Company and CNHTC Group, amendment and rescission of the agreements, etc. On September 22 of the same year, Xiaoya Group and CNHTC Group entered into an agreement for the transfer of shares of Xiaoya Stock Company, stipulating: Xiaoya Group lawfully held 121.59 million state-owned shares of Xiaoya Stock Company, representing 47.87% of the total share capital; Xiaoya Group was willing to transfer 47.48% of the shares of Xiaoya Stock Company, i.e., 120.59 million shares, to CNHTC Group, and CNHTC Group agreed to accept the transfer. Xiaoya Stock Company intended to swap all its assets, except for part of the liabilities that could not be transferred according to law, with part of CNHTC's heavy truck assets.

10. On November 22, 2003, the People's Government of Shandong Province issued a reply (Lu Zheng Zi (2003) No. 486) regarding the asset restructuring of Shandong Xiaoya Electrical Appliance Co., Ltd. The reply stated: Given that Xiaoya Stock Company had been loss-making for two consecutive years and faced the risk of delisting, it was agreed that the company would swap all its assets except for RMB 57.42 million in debt with CNHTC Group's heavy truck production and sales assets (including liabilities), with the difference to be paid in cash.

11. On December 18, 2003, the China Securities Regulatory Commission issued an opinion (Zheng Jian Gong Si Zi (2003) No. 54) to Xiaoya Stock Company on the major asset restructuring plan. The opinion stated: Your company's major asset restructuring plan has been reviewed and approved by the Major Asset Restructuring Review Committee. In 2003, the original Xiaoya Stock Company had been loss-making for two consecutive years and faced delisting risk. With the support and coordination of the government and relevant departments, CNHTC Group restructured Xiaoya Stock Company, resulting in a major asset restructuring plan whereby Xiaoya Group swapped all assets except for RMB 57.42 million with CNHTC Group's heavy truck production and sales assets, and the household appliance assets removed were fully repurchased by the original controlling shareholder, Xiaoya Group. The plan was approved by the People's Government of Shandong Province and approved by the China Securities Regulatory Commission. The asset swap was formally completed on December 31, 2003, and the restructuring was implemented.

12. On December 31, 2003, the confirmation letter on the receipt of assets by Xiaoya Group stated that, based on the transfer agreement, asset swap agreement, and the asset delivery instruction letter from CNHTC Group, Xiaoya Group, as the recipient of the assets removed and transferred under the above two agreements, had fully received all transferred assets and related documents delivered by Xiaoya Stock Company in accordance with the agreement, and the relevant registration procedures were in process.

On January 18, 2004, the business registration name of Xiaoya Stock Company was changed to CNHTC Jinan Truck Co., Ltd., and its business scope, domicile, and legal representative were also changed.

13. From August 15, 2003, to October 20, 2005, Xiaoya Group drew a total of RMB 40 million from CNHTC Group on various grounds such as loans, payment of shell resource fees, share transfer price differences (shell fees), or advances for court enforcement payments. On November 28, 2005, Xiaoya Group and CNHTC Group settled the above amounts, and Xiaoya Group issued a receipt stating: "Received the shell resource fee of RMB 40 million for the asset restructuring of Xiaoya Electrical Appliance Stock Company as agreed by CNHTC Group."

14. On October 15, 2004, the transfer registration confirmation letter issued by the Shenzhen Branch of China Securities Depository and Clearing Co., Ltd. stated that the transferor was Xiaoya Group, the transferee was CNHTC Group, the securities abbreviation was *ST CNHTC, the nature of the shares was initiator state-owned shares, the number of shares transferred was 120.59 million, and the transfer date was October 14, 2004. This was publicly announced in China Securities Journal, Securities Times, and other newspapers on October 18, 2004.

15. On April 6, 2006, the domestic enterprise registration basic information table and certificate issued by the Jinan Municipal Administration for Industry and Commerce confirmed that the Xiaoya Washing Machine Branch was established on January 2, 2004; it passed the annual inspection for 2004; it did not undergo the annual inspection for 2005.

The acquirer (purchaser), Jinan Land Acquisition and Reserve Center, and the acquired party (seller), Xiaoya Stock Company, entered into a contract for the acquisition (purchase) of state-owned land-use rights specialized for the Jingyi Road project (Ji Tu Shou Zi (2004) No. 030), with an appraised land value of RMB 4,048,900 for the plot at No. 73, Dongweizi Outer Street, Lixia District, an appraised value of RMB 2,547,100 for the above-ground buildings, and a total compensation amount of RMB 6,596,000. The demolition compensation was paid by the municipal government to Xiaoya Group. The equipment, land, and real property of Xiaoya Stock Company were under the control and use of the Washing Machine Branch, but remained in the name of Xiaoya Stock Company.

16. On March 11, 2004, East Suburb ICBC sued Xiaoya Group and Xiaoya Washing Machine Branch in the Jinan Intermediate People's Court. During the trial, East Suburb ICBC submitted the confirmation letter, clearly stating that it agreed to transfer its creditor's rights to Xiaoya Group and Xiaoya Washing Machine Branch for repayment, and that the principal debtor was Xiaoya Group and Xiaoya Washing Machine Branch. It also claimed priority compensation from the demolition compensation for the mortgaged real properties, which were under demolition. Xiaoya Group and Xiaoya Washing Machine Branch raised no objection and acknowledged that the debt should be borne by them. On June 24, 2004, the Jinan Intermediate People's Court rendered a civil judgment (2004) Ji Min Si Chu Zi No. 33, holding: According to the five-party agreement, the debt owed by Xiaoya Stock Company to East Suburb ICBC should, under the conditions agreed in the agreement, be transferred together with the repurchased assets to the original Xiaoya Washing Machine Branch. The Xiaoya Washing Machine Branch should bear the debt. As for the validity of the mortgage contract between East Suburb ICBC and Xiaoya Stock Company, since the mortgagor, Xiaoya Stock Company, was not listed as a defendant, it was not reviewed and no support was given. The judgment ordered Xiaoya Group and Xiaoya Washing Machine Branch to repay East Suburb ICBC's loan principal of RMB 5.39 million and interest; and dismissed East Suburb ICBC's other claims. This judgment has become final.

On February 28, 2006, Great Wall Company filed a lawsuit with the Shandong High People's Court, requesting: 1. an order that CNHTC Jinan Truck Company and Xiaoya Group repay the loan principal of RMB 52.68 million; 2. a confirmation that the five mortgage contracts were legal and valid, and that Great Wall Company had priority of compensation over the mortgaged properties; and 3. an order that CNHTC Jinan Truck Company and Xiaoya Group bear the litigation costs and other related expenses.

The Shandong High People's Court held as follows upon trial:

I. The four working capital loan contracts numbered 2003 Dong Liu Zi No. 0022, No. 0023, No. 0024, and No. 0026, and the five mortgage contracts, including the mortgage contracts numbered 2003 Dong Di Zi No. 0022A, No. 0022B, No. 0023A, No. 0023B, and the maximum amount mortgage contract numbered 2003 Dong Di Zi No. 0024, entered into between the original creditor, East Suburb ICBC, and the borrower, Xiaoya Stock Company, all underwent mortgage registration procedures, did not violate prohibitive legal provisions, and were legal and valid. Great Wall Company lawfully acquired the above creditor's rights from East Suburb ICBC by assignment. Great Wall Company and Shandong Branch timely publicly announced the assignment of creditor's rights and the demand for payment in Dazhong Daily. Xiaoya Group's defense that the assignment of creditor's rights had not been transferred was inconsistent with the facts, and the court did not accept it. The total principal of the four loans involved in this case was RMB 102.96 million. After deducting the RMB 5.39 million already adjudicated in another case by a final judgment, the loan principal should be RMB 97.57 million. In this case, Great Wall Company only claimed from the defendants at first instance the repayment of loan principal of RMB 52.68 million. Although this amount was less than RMB 97.57 million, it was an exercise of the plaintiff Great Wall Company's right of disposition, which was in accordance with the law, and the court supported it. The mortgaged properties of the original mortgagor, Xiaoya Stock Company, were all assumed and succeeded by Xiaoya Group. Great Wall Company had the right to be compensated in priority from the proceeds from the auction or sale of the mortgaged properties after discount, auction, or sale.

2.  Whether Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd. should assume liability for repayment of the debts of Xiaoya Joint Stock Company.  First, the process of Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd. purchasing a shell listing can prove that the former and latter (listed) joint stock companies, although formally a change of corporate name, are not a mere name change in the traditional sense.  In substance, the former and latter entities are not the same entity, nor is there a relationship of succession between the old and new entities.  The latter listed company merely acquired the listing qualification of the former listed company.  Second, as can be seen from the content of the confirmation letter issued by the Eastern Suburb Branch of ICBC to Xiaoya Joint Stock Company on August 8, 2003, the creditor, Eastern Suburb Branch of ICBC, agreed with the plan for debts to follow assets and agreed that the company receiving assets from Xiaoya Joint Stock Company should assume the debts of Xiaoya Joint Stock Company.  Although the tentatively named "Shandong Xiaoya Electric Appliances Co., Ltd." was not established, after Xiaoya Group received the assets of Xiaoya Joint Stock Company, it established the "Xiaoya Group Co., Ltd. Washing Machine Branch."  Therefore, the debts in this case should be assumed by Xiaoya Washing Machine Branch and Xiaoya Group.  The fact that, in another effective judgment involving the same parties, the Eastern Suburb Branch of ICBC claimed repayment of the RMB 5.39 million debt involved in this case against Xiaoya Group and Xiaoya Washing Machine Branch further proves that the Eastern Suburb Branch of ICBC knew of and consented to the transfer of the debts of Xiaoya Joint Stock Company, along with its assets, to Xiaoya Group and Xiaoya Washing Machine Branch.  Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd. did not receive any assets from Xiaoya Joint Stock Company.  According to the principle that debts follow assets, the debts of Xiaoya Joint Stock Company should be assumed by Xiaoya Group.  Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd.'s defense that it should not bear liability is well-founded and is adopted by this court.

This court, in accordance with Articles 196 and 198 of the Contract Law of the People's Republic of China, Articles 22, 33, and 34 of the Security Law of the People's Republic of China, and Articles 108 and 120, paragraph 1 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, hereby rules as follows: 1. Xiaoya Group shall, within ten days from the effective date of this judgment, repay the principal of the loan owed to Great Wall Corporation in the amount of RMB 52.68 million; 2. Great Wall Corporation shall have the right to receive priority compensation from the proceeds of converting into money or auctioning or selling, within the scope of the portion not paid under item 1, the real estate, equipment, and machinery mortgaged by Xiaoya Group (formerly Xiaoya Joint Stock Company); 3. Great Wall Corporation shall have the right to receive priority compensation from the demolition compensation fees collected by Xiaoya Group, within the scope of the amount secured by the mortgage for the RMB 5.39 million loan principal; 4. Great Wall Corporation's claim against Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd. is dismissed.  The case acceptance fee of RMB 136,705 and the property preservation fee of RMB 75,000, totaling RMB 211,705, shall be borne by Xiaoya Group.

Appellant Great Wall Corporation, dissatisfied with the above civil judgment of the Shandong High People's Court, appealed to this Court stating: 1. The debts in this case were not transferred.  Although the Eastern Suburb Branch of ICBC signed the five-party agreement and issued a confirmation letter agreeing to Xiaoya Joint Stock Company's restructuring and agreeing with the restructuring plan for the debts of Xiaoya Joint Stock Company to follow assets, because Xiaoya Joint Stock Company failed to perform the five-party agreement as agreed, i.e., did not complete the relevant mortgage registration by September 26, 2003, the confirmation letter became invalid, and consequently, no debt transfer occurred, and the debts remained with the original debtor enterprise.  Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd. and Xiaoya Joint Stock Company are in a relationship of name change; they are the same entity.  Therefore, Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd. should still bear the debts.  2. Regardless of whether the debts in this case were transferred, Great Wall Corporation has always held a mortgage right against Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd.  Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd., by failing to use the proceeds from disposing of the mortgaged property to satisfy the claims secured by the mortgaged property, should bear repayment liability to Great Wall Corporation.  Two legal relationships existed between the Eastern Suburb Branch of ICBC and Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd.: one based on the loan contract creating a creditor-debtor relationship, and another based on the mortgage contract creating a security relationship.  The first instance judgment has confirmed that each mortgage contract is valid and lawful, and Great Wall Corporation has no objection.  According to the contents of the mortgage contracts and the five-party agreement, regardless of whether the debts between the Eastern Suburb Branch of ICBC and Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd. were transferred, the mortgage contracts remained unchanged.  Therefore, Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd. has always been the mortgagor for the Eastern Suburb Branch of ICBC, and its legal liability arising from the mortgage contracts has always existed.  That legal liability is: when the debts are not transferred, if the exercise of the mortgage right by Great Wall Corporation fails to realize the full claim, Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd. shall still bear repayment liability for the shortfall; when the debts are transferred, if the exercise of the mortgage right by Great Wall Corporation fails to realize the full claim, Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd. shall no longer bear repayment liability for the shortfall, which shall be borne by the new debtor.  The asset swap act is an act of transferring ownership of assets.  Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd. has confirmed that the assets swapped out to Sinotruk Group include the mortgaged assets in this case.  Sinotruk Group then transferred the relevant assets to Xiaoya Group.  According to the provisions of the Security Law, Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd. should have used the proceeds obtained from disposing of the mortgaged property to satisfy the claims secured by the mortgaged property.  Of course, after the mortgaged property is disposed of by the mortgagor, the mortgagee has both the right to pursue the mortgaged property and the right to request the mortgagor to directly satisfy the secured debt.  3. Assuming the first instance judgment's view that "debts follow assets" is correct, the entity that received the assets should have been added as a party to this case; the first instance court erroneously omitted a party.  In summary, Great Wall Corporation requests this Court to: 1. reverse item 4 of the main text of the civil judgment of the Shandong High People's Court (2006) Lu Min Er Chu Zi No. 17, and amend it to order Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd. to bear repayment liability; 2. order the appellant's fees to be borne by Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd.

Appellee Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd. argued in defense: 1. The debts in this case have been transferred, and Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd. is not the same entity as Xiaoya Joint Stock Company and should not bear repayment liability.  After the five-party agreement was signed, the Eastern Suburb Branch of ICBC and Xiaoya Joint Stock Company signed four real estate mortgage contracts on September 2, 2003, and one equipment mortgage contract on September 26, 2003.  These five mortgage contracts newly stipulated that "both parties shall complete the mortgage registration procedures with the relevant mortgage registration authorities within 15 days after signing this contract."  After the Eastern Suburb Branch of ICBC and the former Xiaoya Joint Stock Company made new arrangements regarding the mortgage matters, the corresponding provisions of the five-party agreement became invalid, and the parties should comply with the stipulations of the mortgage contracts that were signed last.  In fact, the equipment mortgage registration certificate was issued 3 days after the mortgage contract was signed, i.e., on September 29, 2003; the mortgage certificates for the two properties were issued 7 days after the mortgage contracts were signed, i.e., on September 9, 2003.  For the two land use rights mortgages, applications for mortgage registration were submitted to the registration authorities before September 10, 2003, and formal approval was obtained on September 28, 2003.  Therefore, Xiaoya Joint Stock Company's completion of the mortgage registration fully complied with the stipulations of the mortgage contracts.  Additionally, the mortgage contracts are ancillary contracts to the loan contracts.  The loan periods for the loans secured by the equipment and land use rights all commenced on September 30, 2003.  The completion of the mortgage registration procedures in this case fully met the bank's work requirements.  In summary, the parties adjusted and changed the relevant dates in the five-party agreement, loan contracts, and mortgage registrations based on actual circumstances, and performed them appropriately.  During the performance, none of the parties, including the Eastern Suburb Branch of ICBC, raised any objections.  Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd. and Xiaoya Joint Stock Company are not in a relationship of a mere name change in the traditional sense.  They are not the same entity, nor is there a relationship of succession between the old and new entities.  Therefore, Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd. should not bear the debts in this case.  2. Great Wall Corporation's claim that Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd. should bear debt repayment liability based on the mortgage security legal relationship has no legal or factual basis.  The restructuring in this case was essentially an enterprise restructuring act of merging Xiaoya Joint Stock Company into Xiaoya Group.  Through the overall asset swap, Xiaoya Group actually received and controlled the overall assets (including debts) of Xiaoya Joint Stock Company.  Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd. and Xiaoya Joint Stock Company are two different entities, with no relationship of legal succession.  Therefore, Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd. should not bear the debts, nor should it bear any security liability.  3. Great Wall Corporation's ground for appeal that the first instance court omitted a litigation subject has no factual basis.  During the trial of this case by the first instance court, Xiaoya Group applied to add Jinan Xiaoya Washing Machine Factory as a third party.  The first instance court also inquired of Great Wall Corporation whether it agreed to the addition.  Great Wall Corporation expressly refused the addition.  This was Great Wall Corporation, as the plaintiff, voluntarily exercising its rights.  The first instance court respected the will of the parties.  Great Wall Corporation's ground for appeal that the first instance court omitted a subject should not be sustained.  In summary, the first instance judgment found the facts clearly and applied the law appropriately, and should be affirmed.

The original defendant Xiaoya Group did not submit a written defense opinion.

After the second-instance court examination of evidence, the facts found by the original trial judgment are confirmed, and additionally it is found that:

On September 2, 2003, Xiaoya Joint Stock Company and the Eastern Suburb Branch of ICBC respectively signed Mortgage Contract No. 2003 Dong Di Zi No. 0022A, No. 0022B, No. 0023A, and No. 0023B.  The mortgaged properties stated in these four mortgage contracts are, respectively, the houses and land use rights on the land at No. 73 Dongweiwaixiao Street, Lixia District, Jinan City, and the houses and land use rights on the land at No. 38 Erqi Zhongjie Street, Shizhong District, Jinan City.  These four contracts also state: "Both parties shall complete the mortgage registration procedures with the relevant local mortgage registration authorities within 15 days after signing this contract."  Subsequently, the parties, under the supervision of the Jinan Municipal Bureau of Land and Resources, signed two Jinan City State-Owned Land Use Rights Mortgage Contracts, stipulating the mortgage of the land use rights for the land at No. 73 Dongweiwaixiao Street, Lixia District, Jinan City, and the land at No. 38 Erqi Zhongjie Street, Shizhong District, Jinan City, respectively, and stipulating: "The mortgaging parties shall, within 15 days after signing the mortgage contract, apply for land use rights mortgage registration with the Municipal Bureau of Land and Resources."  The date of signing is not indicated on these two contracts.

On September 9, 2003, the Jinan Municipal Bureau of Real Estate Administration issued the house mortgage certificates for the houses on the land at No. 73 Dongweiwaixiao Street, Lixia District, Jinan City, and the land at No. 38 Erqi Zhongjie Street, Shizhong District, Jinan City.

On September 10, 2003, the Jinan Municipal Bureau of Land and Resources completed the preliminary examination of the application for mortgage registration for the land use rights at No. 73 Dongweiwaixiao Street, Lixia District, Jinan City, and issued the land mortgage certificate on September 29 of the same year.  On September 18, 2003, the Jinan Municipal Bureau of Land and Resources completed the preliminary examination of the application for mortgage registration for the land use rights at No. 38 Erqi Zhongjie Street, Shizhong District, Jinan City, and issued the land mortgage certificate on September 29 of the same year.

On September 26, 2003, Xiaoya Joint Stock Company and the Eastern Suburb Branch of ICBC signed the "Maximum Amount Mortgage Contract" No. 2003 Dong Di Zi No. 0024, stipulating the creation of a mortgage over certain machinery and electronic equipment and stipulating: "Both parties shall complete the mortgage registration procedures with the relevant local mortgage registration authorities within 15 days after signing this contract."  On September 29 of the same year, the Shandong Provincial Administration for Industry and Commerce issued the mortgage registration certificate.

This Court holds that: The parties in this case have no dispute in the second instance regarding the validity and performance of the loan contracts involved in this case, nor do they have any objection to the related assignment of claims.  The request submitted by Great Wall Corporation to this Court is for a judgment ordering Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd. to assume mortgage security repayment liability.  Therefore, this Court's second-instance trial only addresses this appellate request of Great Wall Corporation.  Based on the appellate arguments and defense reasons of the parties in the second instance, the main issues in dispute in this case are: 1. whether the confirmation letter issued by the Eastern Suburb Branch of ICBC on August 8, 2003, the five-party agreement signed by the Eastern Suburb Branch of ICBC, Xiaoya Joint Stock Company, and others on the same day, and the corresponding performance constitute that the debts of Xiaoya Joint Stock Company to the Eastern Suburb Branch of ICBC were assumed by Xiaoya Group; 2. whether Great Wall Corporation holds a mortgage right over the mortgaged property involved in this case; 3. whether the original trial court omitted a litigation subject.

1.  Regarding whether the debts of Xiaoya Joint Stock Company to the Eastern Suburb Branch of ICBC were assumed by Xiaoya Group.  (1) Concerning the agreement between the Eastern Suburb Branch of ICBC and Xiaoya Joint Stock Company on the time for completing the mortgage registration.  According to the facts found by this Court, although the five-party agreement stipulated that all registration procedures must be completed before September 26, 2003, Xiaoya Joint Stock Company and the Eastern Suburb Branch of ICBC re-signed two mortgage contracts concerning the land use rights on September 2, 2003, and signed one mortgage contract concerning machinery and equipment on September 26 of the same year, and re-stipulated the time for completing mortgage registration with the relevant registration authorities as "within 15 days after the contract is signed."  Therefore, it should be considered that the parties changed the time for completing the mortgage registration stipulated in the five-party agreement by means of a contract.  This change is lawful and valid.  (2) Regarding the performance of the aforementioned two mortgage contracts by Xiaoya Joint Stock Company.  According to the facts found in the second instance, the Jinan Municipal Bureau of Land and Resources completed the preliminary examination of the applications for mortgage registration of the land use rights at No. 73 Dongweiwaixiao Street, Lixia District, Jinan City, and at No. 38 Erqi Zhongjie Street, Shizhong District, Jinan City, on September 10 and 18, 2003, respectively.  It can be determined that Xiaoya Joint Stock Company submitted the application materials for mortgage registration to the land registration authorities before September 10, 2003.  The mortgage registration certificate for the relevant machinery and equipment was issued on September 29, 2003.  Therefore, it should be determined that Xiaoya Joint Stock Company submitted the application materials for registration to the relevant registration authorities within the period stipulated in the aforementioned three mortgage contracts and ultimately completed the relevant mortgage registration.  That is, Xiaoya Joint Stock Company did not violate the contract terms in completing the mortgage registration.  The conditions for the invalidation of the confirmation letter issued by the Eastern Suburb Branch of ICBC were not met.  According to the contents of the confirmation letter and the five-party agreement, and the fact that Xiaoya Group received the corresponding property, the debts of Xiaoya Joint Stock Company to the Eastern Suburb Branch of ICBC had been assumed by Xiaoya Group.  Great Wall Corporation's appeal ground that Xiaoya Joint Stock Company failed to complete the mortgage registration within the agreed time, that the corresponding confirmation letter became invalid, and that the debts remained in the name of Xiaoya Joint Stock Company has no factual basis and is not supported by this Court.  The fact that Xiaoya Group assumed the debts of Xiaoya Joint Stock Company makes the question of whether Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd. and Xiaoya Joint Stock Company are the same entity unimportant, because in this situation, regardless of whether the two are the same entity, Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd. should not bear the civil liability for repaying the loan principal and interest in this case as the principal debtor of Great Wall Corporation.  Therefore, Great Wall Corporation's appellate request that the debts in this case were not transferred and that Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd. should still bear repayment liability has no factual or legal basis and is not supported by this Court.

2.  Regarding the validity of the mortgage rights involved in this case and the identification of the relevant mortgagor.  Each mortgage contract involved in this case is valid and lawful, and the parties to the contracts completed the mortgage registration for the corresponding mortgaged property; therefore, each mortgage right involved in this case is validly established.  These mortgage rights also transferred to the new creditor, Great Wall Corporation, along with the transfer of the principal claims.  After the establishment of these mortgage rights, the relevant property registration has not been changed.  Xiaoya Joint Stock Company was the mortgagor at the time of establishment of the mortgage security rights in this case.  Due to the asset swap and the change in business registration, its name is now Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd.  Also, because the contents of the mortgage certificates have not been subjected to any change registration, the mortgagor in the mortgage security legal relationship nominally remains Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd.  Therefore, Great Wall Corporation's appeal ground that Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd. is the mortgagor under the Eastern Suburb Branch of ICBC's mortgage right is well-founded and is supported by this Court.  However, mortgage security is security in rem.  Where the mortgagor is not the principal debtor, the mortgagee can only realize the claim against the mortgagor within the scope of the mortgaged property.  The mortgagee may request the conversion into money or auction or sale of the mortgaged property for priority compensation, but may not request the mortgagor to directly assume the debtor's debt.  Therefore, this Court does not support Great Wall Corporation's second-instance request for Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co., Ltd. to directly repay the debt.  Great Wall Corporation has the right to receive priority compensation from the proceeds of converting into money or auctioning or selling the corresponding mortgaged property, or from the expropriation compensation, within the scope that Xiaoya Group fails to pay the relevant debts.

3.  Regarding whether the first instance court omitted a litigation subject.  Great Wall Corporation, as the original trial plaintiff, when asked by the original trial court whether it wished to add Jinan Xiaoya Washing Machine Factory as a defendant, expressly stated that it did not apply for the addition.  Therefore, its appeal ground that the original trial court omitted a litigation subject in this case has no factual basis and is not supported by this Court.

In summary, the original trial judgment's findings of facts are basically clear, and its application of the law is basically correct, except for an impropriety in identifying the relevant mortgagor.  This Court, in accordance with Articles 153, paragraph 1, subparagraphs (1) and (3) of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, hereby rules as follows:

1.  Items 1 and 3 of the main text of the civil judgment of the Shandong High People's Court (2006) Lu Min Er Chu Zi No. 17 are affirmed;

2.  Items 2 and 4 of the main text of the civil judgment of the Shandong High People's Court (2006) Lu Min Er Chu Zi No. 17 are reversed;

3.  China Great Wall Asset Management Corporation, Jinan Office, shall have the right to receive priority compensation from the proceeds of converting into money or auctioning or selling the mortgaged property under Mortgage Contract No. 2003 Dong Di Zi No. 0023A, No. 2003 Dong Di Zi No. 0023B, and the Maximum Amount Mortgage Contract No. 2003 Dong Di Zi No. 0024, within the scope of the debts secured by each of these three guarantee contracts that Shandong Xiaoya Group Co., Ltd. fails to pay, as confirmed by item 1 of the main text of the original trial judgment;

4.  The other claims of China Great Wall Asset Management Corporation, Jinan Office, are dismissed.

If the monetary obligation is not paid within the period specified in this judgment, the interest on the debt for delayed performance shall be doubled in accordance with Article 232 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China.

According to Article 219 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the period for applying for enforcement in this case is six months, calculated from the last day of the performance period.

The first-instance case acceptance fee of RMB 136,705 and the property preservation fee of RMB 75,000, totaling RMB 211,705, shall be borne by Shandong Xiaoya Group Co., Ltd.  The second-instance case acceptance fee of RMB 136,705 shall be borne by China Great Wall Asset Management Corporation, Jinan Office.

This judgment is final.
